data.title: 神罚 · 海边木屋的落日热浪
data.description: 夕阳沉入海平面的暮光下，私密海滩木屋纱幔拂动。神罚跨坐在你腿上，比基尼挂脖系带微松，双臂紧紧环抱着你的脖颈，落日金红光芒勾勒出发烫泛红的雪肌。
data.location: private wooden beach cabana at golden sunset
data.action: straddling lap in beach cabana, untied bikini halter strings held in fingers, flushed skin, arms wrapped around neck
data.lighting: rich golden hour sunset glow blending with ocean reflections
data.mood: steamy romantic intimacy, flushed desire, sunset glow
data.promptProse: Sitting on partner lap inside a sunset beach cabana, Modernia blushes with her bikini straps untied, embracing neck amidst ocean breeze.
data.animaCaption: Modernia embracing closely inside a sunset beach cabana with untied bikini.
